m3.note: M3_R = M2_R ∩ reach∈{verified,plausible} ∩ delivery_verified.  Classes recomputed over M3_R from the v6 ledger grader artifacts (untouched). M3_cal ⊆ M3_orig since M2_cal ⊆ M2_orig.

evidence_scoping_check.note: Detail strings name content/lineage reach at the row (DAG) level, not a checkpoint key: the execution-level join across rules is the correct construction.  If a detail were checkpoint-scoped, rows whose rule-flagged checkpoint set did not cover the evidence checkpoint would be excluded — none are.
